result.summary: The food delivery home screen renders mostly well. The main visible defect is a badge on the second 'Popular right now' card showing '–0%', which indicates a broken/empty discount value being rendered. Other elements (header, search, chips, promo banner, carousels) appear intact.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card in 'Popular right now' displays a discount badge reading '–0%'. A zero-percent discount is meaningless and suggests the discount value is missing or defaulting to 0, producing a broken-looking label.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0 or null, or ensure the correct discount percentage is populated from the data source.
